title: iPhone free for 1 h 24 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 1 h 24 min (since 12:09Z; released by fix-end-morph (process hold ended)). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: end-fresh (owner arch-end-fresh; its next step names the phone (unmarked)).
What unblocks it: the next of arch-end-fresh takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

False alarm: the iPhone is free on purpose; the next phone test (P-163) first needs a 10-15 min Simulator check that I asked for.
- I marked that on the board, so the alarm is cleared.
- The phone test starts after the Simulator check, run by arch-end-fresh.

What you need to do: nothing.
